'''Version 1.7.0''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on April 4th 2020.  It was 4.68 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

==== <u>Fixes</u> ====

* Fixed mobs spawning when they are disable
* Potential fix for error in Loot Event

==== <u>Changes</u> ====

* Tweaked attack AI for air type mobs.
* Reduced [[Primitive Yelloweye]] hitbox size.
* There is now a mob list for Beckons<ref>See: [[Stage I Beckon]], [[Stage II Beckon]], [[Stage III Beckon]]</ref> and Summoners<ref>Both [[Primitive Summoner|Primitive]] and [[Adapted Summoner|Adapted Summoners]].</ref> (mobs from other mods will work, if mob attacking is true the Beckons and Summoners will target them).
* Some [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Infected versions]] now has an option for spawning mobs on death.
* There is an option to change the spawning chance for the Walking Heads.
* The [[Reinforcement System|reinforcement system]] will no longer spawn [[Stage I Beckon|Beckons]] on infested blocks.
* Tweaked block infestation timer, now to infest nearby blocks it has to wait said cooldown in config file.
* Changed model for [[Buglin]].
* Buglin can now grow into a [[Rupter]].
* Changed Model for [[Adapted Longarms]].
* Tweaked experience points for each mob.
* Tweaked/changed textures for [[:Category:Primitive Parasites|primitive]] and [[:Category:Adapted Parasites|adapted]] versions.
* Tweaked Infected Wolf Head animation.
* Tweaked [[Adapted Reeker]] animation
* Tweaked Beckons models.
* Tweaked particles for the death animations.
* [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Infected]] versions and the [[Primitive Bolster|Primitive]] and [[Adapted Bolster]] will be the only ones to have the swell animations, the others will just explode (will be tweaking this later on).
* Tweaked texture for the [[Living Bow|Living Greatbow]] and for all weapon parts.
* Changed color for the fog in the block infestation.
* Added an option for light level and block revert for the Infestation System.
* Beckons can now infest blocks below their root, [[Stage II Beckon|Stage II]] will go down by 1 and [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III]] will go down by 2.
* Mobs that are disable will no longer be registered into the game.
* Added sounds for the Walking Heads and for the mob that can shoot
* [[Assimilated Big Spider|Infected Dorpa]] Web blocks will now despawn.
* Removed option "Lodo spawn number" for the [[Flying Carrier]] category.

==== <u>New Content</u> ====

* When a Beckon is killed, the infested block will turn into dirt (default) and if the block above is air, it will turn into [[Residue|Infested Residue]] (new block, these can spawn Beckons).
* Added a new mob type: [[:Category:Ancient Parasites|Ancient]]
*# Parasites who have lived long enough to become stronger and more dangerous, you can find 2 of them now ([[Overlord|Ancient Overlord]], [[Dreadnaut|Ancient Dreadnaut]]).
*# Killing [[Stage III Beckon|Beckons Stage III]] makes them angry and in the worst case scenario, they will come after you (they don't despawn).

* Added mob: [[Moving Flesh]]
* Added fusion system
*# The infected now have the ability to learn from their battles and if the conditions are met, they will start to melt until they're some Moving Flesh.
*# If 2 of these things meet, they will fuse together and grow, if they are big enough they will spawn a [[:Category:Primitive Parasites|primitive mob]] (with half his total health) (Infected Dorpa is the only one that will not melt).

* Added mob: [[Vigilante]]
*# First ground mob able to shoot, they will spawn from Beckons Stage III
*# They are built for territory defense purposes so they don't have a spawn rate.

<u>EDIT</u>:

* Conditions for the infected to turn into Moving Flesh:
*# The first condition: the infected needs to reach the primitive killcount..
*# The second condition: it needs to be next to 3 more infected, regardless of their killcount/specie OR it needs to be next to a Moving Flesh.
*# If the infected with the killcount is next to al least 3 more infected, the four of them will start to melt BUT if it is next to a Moving flesh, only it will start to melt.
